evidence: Matches the 'Wallet' label and modifies wallet descriptor handling in src/wallet/scriptpubkeyman.cpp and src/wallet/imports.cpp.
rationale: Fixes node aborts and persistent inverted range states triggered by importing descriptors with extreme range endpoints or oversized keypools. As noted in the description, 'importing [2147483647, 2147483647] produces an end of 2^31, which narrows to a negative value and aborts the node during keypool top-up', along with multiple signed integer overflows under UBSan.
